_about: The kit capacity ratchet (docs/ux-system/kit-v2.md §8.6, test/kit/kit_capacity_test.dart). Each entry is a scene that breaks the contract in test/kit/kit_capacity.json today, with the measured value: error/cut/target/items count the failing combinations (or nodes, or items drawn), width is dp painted at 1,600 dp. The file only shrinks: a new violation fails, a worse value fails, a better or fixed one fails until this file is tightened (KIT_CAPACITY_WRITE=1 rewrites it, never adding an entry).
